channel.title: Wildcard Watch: Joomla!
channel.description: Exploited vulnerabilities and attacks involving Joomla!, each with its fix status and first step.

item.title: Patch now: Joomla! released security patches for 58 vulnerabilities, including 4 critical, 23 high, 29 medium and 2 low
item.description:
Joomla! (multiple products): fix available · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the security update for the affected Joomla! products. The CCB advisory lists the affected and fixed versions.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Fix available
